INDEPENDENTLY VERIFY OR REFUTE THIS DEFECT CLAIM about the staged Orca execution code:

CLAIM: In mission_scheduler.js, when a worker handler performs an external effect and then throws, the mission is recorded as FAILED instead of UNKNOWN. Note the timeout path in the same catch deliberately goes to _reconcileUnknown, never FAILED.

YOUR JOB: (1) confirm or refute each link in that chain by reading the staged files yourself, quoting exact lines; (2) check whether the catch path can distinguish a pre-effect throw (handler threw before any effect, where FAILED-with-retry is arguably safe) from a post-effect throw; (3) check failure_record.js for any post-effect reconciliation that would mitigate this.

DELIVERABLE: one verdict line: DEFECT_CONFIRMED (chain holds as claimed; cite the three key lines), DEFECT_REFUTED (a link in the chain is wrong; say which with evidence), or DEFECT_PARTIAL (holds with a stated qualification). Then at most five evidence bullets.
